comment: Growth-content config for ingest-growth.ts. Quote targets are Bartlett's (1905, PG #27889) author-header substrings; concept targets are Wikipedia REST summary pages. Tag taxonomy per AGENTS.md 1.7.

quotes.actionLine: Try this today: name one outside event you will stop arguing with.

Try this today: copy Franklin's one-virtue-a-week tracking page.
Try this today: spend one hour on one task with no screen nearby.
Try this today: trust one of your own ideas before asking for applause.

concepts.actionLine: Try this today: make one good habit 2 minutes easier to start.
Try this today: start the task for 10 minutes, timer on.
Try this today: compute one year of growth on your savings at 8%.
Try this today: batch one 50-minute no-phone work block.
Try this today: drill your weakest sub-skill with instant feedback.
Try this today: re-read one saved card from three days ago.
Try this today: pre-decide one consistent response to a trigger.
Try this today: timebox tomorrow's hardest task for 25 minutes.
Try this today: repeat back one speaker's point before replying.
Try this today: park your phone 30 minutes before bed.
Try this today: set up one small automatic savings transfer.
Try this today: wait 10 minutes before one small impulse buy.
